rules.note: Two people meeting at a doorway should not have to take turns.
A round room reports its diameter here, which is the closest this schema comes to knowing it is round.
Under the dome as under the annexe's flat ceiling.
About 15 m2, with the central pier taken out of it.
You have to be able to stand where you land.
The annexe is off to one side. A round room does not put its own back room on show.
